candidates.why_maybe_new: No roster row covers it; length unknown (possibly 30-60 km, unverified).

seed_ledger.name: Kalanchak - Skadovsk
seed_ledger.reason: OSM ~40 km regional branch in Kherson Oblast; no sourced length, operator or year found in one search; likely Soviet-era Ukrtransgaz/oblast branch. Length unsourced, so monitor.

seed_ledger.name: Dzhanoy - Simferopol
seed_ledger.reason: OSM ~92 km; probably part of the old Kherson-Simferopol main (Ukrtransgaz, built ~40 years before 2003) in Crimea. No segment length sourced. Not a roster match (P1465 is the Dashava-Moscow trunk). Related Armyansk-Dzhankoy 75 km line (Ukrtransgaz, built 2003-2011) is a separate lead not in the roster.

seed_ledger.name: Strelkovoe - Dzhankoy
seed_ledger.reason: OSM ~55 km field line from Strelkove field (Kherson Oblast) to Dzhankoy; search results confirm gas moved Strelkove to Dzhankoy, but no sourced length. Monitor.

seed_ledger.name: Voloske - Zhovti Vody
seed_ledger.reason: OSM ~122 km in Dnipropetrovsk Oblast, 21 in; no sourced spec or operator page found; probably Soviet-era branch of the Kryvyi Rih/Dnipro trunks (P1460/P0783 area). Monitor.

seed_ledger.name: Donetsk - Kurakhove
seed_ledger.reason: OSM ~37 km Donetsk Oblast branch (12 in); no sourced length. Monitor.

seed_ledger.name: Kostiantynivka - Krasnoarmeysk
seed_ledger.reason: OSM ~48 km Donetsk Oblast branch (15 in); no sourced length. May overlap P1488 Kramatorsk-Donetsk-Mariupol corridor; unconfirmed. Monitor.

seed_ledger.name: Stryi - Kolomyia
seed_ledger.reason: OSM ~129 km Carpathian branch (11 in); one Ukrainian search found no Stryi-Kolomyia spec. Likely a Prykarpattia branch near P1462/P1463 corridor; unconfirmed. Monitor.

seed_ledger.name: Dzhankoi-Genichesk Gas Pipeline
seed_ledger.reason: Real line: rebuilt/extended in reverse flow Crimea to Henichesk, completed Oct 2023 (RIA, Russian-installed administration). Earlier Russia run dropped it only as out_of_slice, not on substance. Not in Ukraine roster (P5989/P7817/P7818 are Taganrog-Melitopol-Berdyansk). Length unknown; queued per length-unknown rule.
